data.name: Khateer
data.gender_notes: Khateer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khata'a', meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the blessings and favors bestowed upon an individual by Allah. The name Khateer carries the meaning “Gifted or Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khateer usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted or generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to be grateful for the blessings received and to strive for generosity towards others.
data.etymology: Khateer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted or Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khateer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
